PR: `fluxcd/flux2/action`: Determine latest version without using GitHub API [closed; labels area/ci]
Currently, creating a workflow that `uses: fluxcd/flux2/action@main` requires a GitHub API token, even the workflow is being run on a platform other than GitHub (e.g. [Forgejo](https://forgejo.org/docs/latest/user/actions/overview/)). This is because the GitHub API is called to determine the latest version (and only to determine the latest version), and GitHub rate-limits access to their API endpoint.

This PR modifies `action.yml` so that the action gathers latest version information from `gi…

from `api.github.com`, which avoids the rate-limiting problem entirely. This, in turn, allows for the removal of the token-related input/variable, and removes a usability pain-point for non-GitHub platforms
